## Problem

Predict the sale price of 21,613 houses sold in King County (Seattle area) between 2014 and 2015.

## Approach

Geographic analysis with GeoPandas and Folium, log transformation of the target and hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [GeoPandas]{.tag} [Folium]{.tag} [Ray Tune]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag} [XGBoost]{.tag} [Optuna]{.tag} [SHAP]{.tag}

## Results

XGBoost tuned with Ray Tune + Optuna reached **R² 0.911** (log scale), **MAPE 11.5%** and MAE of US$64,191, versus 43.8% MAPE for the baseline and 19.9% for linear regression. SHAP analysis showed that waterfront, present in only 163 houses, raises the price by about 35% when it exists.
